[h1]Excellently polished, arcade-ey, frantic, unforgiving game.[/h1]
Gobs of unlockable items, 11 unlockable characters, and Steam/in-game achievements will keep you busy.
[b]4/5 stars.[/b]
------------------------------
Risk of Rain is a zone-based roguelike platformer, built for quick sessions or long stints of play (you can die very fast, or survive for hours).

Gameplay revolves around the player finding a portal in each zone, eliminating a boss and a wave of enemies once the portal is activated, and fighting enemies and opening chests for new abilites along the way.
------------------------------

I love the unlockable characters, items, and modifiers for use in the game. Each character plays differently with their own abilities. Once you unlock more characters, you will find your own favorite playstyle(s) and item builds. [spoiler]There is a modifier which lets you choose which item you unlock per chest, instead of it being random. This lets you make builds easier to rek enemies more bettor.[/spoiler]

What I [b]would[/b] like to see is more level variety. There are a good handful (I think 10 styles, and they vary between layouts), but I'd like to see more.

Also, [b]Risk of Rain needs a better multiplayer experience.[/b] It works, but it's an IP / port configuration system, which can feel rough for some people.

Interactions between players (say, item trading) would be cool to see, in case I pick up something that the other person needs.

I don't get it. I like roguelikes. I like platformers. But I simply don't understand this.

I think it's what other reviewers pointed out: the game forces you to play in a weird and alien way that's hard to feel and understand.
unlocked about 7 characters and save file was just blank when i started game today... cool.. was fun but im not replaying it all.. sux

A very fun game for co op, single player is fun as well but not as fun as multiplayer. So much chaos running around killing stuffs with a large variety of characters and items. Able to have many different builds (mostly random) to farm endless amount of level. Able to change difficulty if the game progress too slow or too fast. A great pickup to play co op with friends as it's cheap and good. Able to play for quite a long amount of time.

Frame skip made this game playable, I don't know if I like it.
